A half-derelict '''orbital station''' [[Orbit/Legends|circled]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Saqqar]] that was located within the [[Saqqar system/Legends|Saqqar system]] of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called [[The Dead Road]]. The [[Space station/Legends|space station]] served the needs of the few [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that traveled along the hyperlane.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The orbital station was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square T-11.<ref name="TEA" />
